title: Deliver through a freshness-checked outbox with independent outcome receipts
summary: Implement a neutral delivery port and durable outbox. Refuse known stale advice at a declared dispatch boundary while describing external transport uncertainty honestly instead of claiming universal exactly-once sending.
out_of_scope: Email, Slack, or agent transport adapters
implementation: Prepare immutable intents with context/dependency snapshots and permitted destination authority.
Fence dispatch with final freshness, recovery, baseline, epoch, permission, and budget checks.
Represent transport idempotency/query capabilities and explicit delivery_unknown after ambiguous failure.
Advance baseline only on the declared observed success milestone; append later outcomes independently.

acceptance.criterion: Recovery or cancellation before dispatch prevents sending queued advice.
acceptance.verification: Block a fake transport boundary and mutate state.

acceptance.criterion: Ambiguous send outcomes cannot fabricate success or blind duplicate-free retry.
acceptance.verification: Test transports with and without idempotency or receipt lookup.

acceptance.criterion: Competing equivalent intents cannot repeat the same delivered delta.
acceptance.verification: Race workers and inspect fencing, reservations, and baseline receipts.

tests: Withheld intents do not advance baseline.
Audience change before dispatch invalidates intent.
Delivered does not imply consumption, repair, or usefulness.
Cancellation after completed send preserves actual transport history.
risks: A local transaction cannot make arbitrary external transport exactly-once.

reuse.application: Use independent outcome stages and immediate dispatch freshness checks.
